### CodeBlockContent

<ApiTable kind="props" :items='[
  {
    "name": "code",
    "type": "string",

  },
  {
    "name": "lines",
    "type": "CodeToken[][] | null",

    "description": "<p>Highlighted tokens from <code>useHighlightedCode</code>, one array per line. Plain text is shown until they arrive.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "language",
    "type": "string",

  },
  {
    "name": "wrap",

    "required": false,

  },
  {
    "name": "lineNumbers",
    "type": "boolean",

    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Numbers each line. Numbers are not selected or copied.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "startLine",
    "type": "number",
    "default": "1",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Number of the first line when <code>lineNumbers</code> is set.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "highlightLines",
    "type": "LineSelector",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Lines to highlight, as <code>&amp;quot;1,4-6&amp;quot;</code> or <code>[1, 4, 5, 6]</code>. Counts lines of <code>code</code> from 1, whatever <code>startLine</code> is.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "focusLines",
    "type": "LineSelector",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Lines to keep in focus while the others are dimmed. Same format as <code>highlightLines</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "addedLines",
    "type": "LineSelector",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Lines to show as added. Same format as <code>highlightLines</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "removedLines",
    "type": "LineSelector",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Lines to show as removed. Same format as <code>highlightLines</code>.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "diff",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Reads a leading <code>+</code>, <code>-</code>, or space on each line as a diff marker and hides it.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "notation",
    "type": "boolean",
    "default": "false",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Reads <code>[!code highlight]</code>, <code>[!code focus]</code>, <code>[!code ++]</code>, <code>[!code --]</code>, and <code>[!code word:…]</code> comments and hides them.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "highlightWords",
    "type": "WordMatcher[]",
    "default": "[]",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Words or regular expressions to mark on every line.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "maxHeight",
    "type": "string | number",
    "required": false,
    "description": "<p>Caps the height; the content scrolls inside. A number is in pixels.</p>"
  },
  {
    "name": "collapsedHeight",
    "type": "string | number",

  {
    "name": "tabindex",
    "type": "number | \"auto\"",
    "default": "\"auto\"",
